supersession.reason: Later Brad authority requires zero source-touch gating, any-subset completion, and no active-player or attendance prerequisite for the final release.
supersession.history_policy: The M2 predicate receipt remains exact evidence of the earlier contract. This overlay is the current runtime authority for the two named nodes and does not rewrite that receipt.

global_rules.legacy_telemetry_fields: RP03 stores its one voluntary actor in the existing ballot telemetry shape for conduct-verdict compatibility. Field names do not create eligibility.

nodes.participant_selection: the linked non-spectator actor who operates one exact marker; no other player is enrolled
nodes.accepted_action: one exact PUBLISH or RELEASE_UNNAMED marker operation
nodes.wrong_or_failed_action: unlinked actor, invalid marker, or persistence failure changes no branch
nodes.commit: persist name treatment, one-actor RP03 telemetry, and derived conduct exactly once; both branches release Averyn

nodes.participant_selection: the linked Protocol Bridge depositor only; nearby, online, disconnected, and absent players are not enrolled

branch_operation.condemn: leave the branch-marked Bridge in the black housing, then confirm
branch_operation.understand: pass to a willing second player or use the five-second solo self-hold, then place in amber and confirm
branch_operation.free: carry the Bridge from center to the white release trough, then confirm

nodes.wrong_or_failed_action: reset only the uncommitted confirmation attempt; preserve Wren and name choices
nodes.commit: persist finale-ready receipt, voluntary participant UUID, and same Protocol Bridge identity exactly once
